title: Without See Financial Data a line's pricing source and details are withheld
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a category A part added.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at where the part's sell price shows.
  3. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens with the part line.

Step 2:

  • The part's price is hidden as line prices are today.
  • No price details open.
  • The part line's description and quantity show.

Step 3:

  • The Parts tab lists the part.
  • It has no Priced by column.
